cards.name: Throne of the Grim Captain // The Grim Captain

name: Scarab God: Lock & Loot
notes: Nov 24 2026 (later): Splinter's Technique in for Codex Shredder (4-mana Demonic Tutor; sneak rarely matters here) and Shredder's Revenge in for Night's Whisper (target player discards two, or draws two and loses 2; point the discard at yourself to bin a Surfer-tutored Galactus).

Nov 24 2026 (later): rack package in from a spare set on hand (the Doom decks keep their copies). The Rack in for Doom Blade, Skullcage in for Pongify, Cursed Rack in for Treasure Cruise. Necrogen Mists, Bottomless Pit, Hymn, Mind Twist, Shredder's Revenge and the Tinybones keep hands under three for The Rack; Skullcage hits anyone not at exactly 3-4; Cursed Rack caps your biggest-handed opponent at four.

Nov 24 2026 (later): Muddle the Mixture and Perplex in for Counterspell (not on hand) and Arcane Denial. Negate stays until a Counterspell turns up, then swap Negate out. Muddle transmutes for MV 2 (Animate Dead, Waste Not, Liliana's Caress, Glimpse, Millstone, Skullcage); Perplex transmutes for MV 3 (Necrogen Mists, Bottomless Pit, Fraying Sanity, Toxic Deluge, Shredder's Revenge) and its counter makes them discard their hand.

Nov 24 2026: Galactus package in. Silver Surfer, Galactus's Herald in for Sign in Blood; Galactus, Devourer of Worlds in for Hero's Downfall. Both from the ripped Fantastic Four precon. Line: Surfer tutors Galactus to hand, your own Necrogen Mists / Bottomless Pit / Shredder's Revenge discard him (or mill him with Hedron Crab on yourself, Glimpse, Throne), then Animate Dead / Reanimate / Dread Return. Scarab God can also exile Galactus from any graveyard for a 4/4 token copy that keeps flying, trample, indestructible and the exile trigger. Controlling Surfer turns off Galactus's forced attack.
Nov 24 2026: new discard + mill deck. Doom's Big Wheels stays the punish-the-wheel deck; this one locks hands and libraries, then plays the table's graveyards.

Plan: Necrogen Mists / Bottomless Pit / Black Vise empty hands; mill engines (Phenax, Captain N'ghathrod, crabs, Fraying Sanity, Tasha's Hideous Laughter, Traumatize) dump libraries; The Scarab God, Geth, Breach the Multiverse, Grave Betrayal, Rise of the Dread Marn and the reanimation spells turn their graveyards into your board.
Wins: Scarab God upkeep drain per Zombie, Gul Dukat doubling life loss, The Rack / Skullcage / Black Vise upkeep damage, Exsanguinate, Psychosis Crawler, Szadek, Galactus, or decking.

Throne of the Grim Captain only mills you (fuel for reanimation). Craft needs a Dinosaur, Merfolk, Pirate and Vampire: Merfolk Secretkeeper, Captain N'ghathrod (Pirate) and Szadek (Vampire) are in the deck; a stolen Dinosaur finishes it.
No graveyard hate in this deck on purpose (Leyline of the Void would exile your own loot).

Value at Nov 12 prices: 99 about $143, cards to buy about $65 plus the Scarab God. Nov 24 Galactus swap: Galactus (regular printing ~$3-8) and Surfer add value to the 99, so it may now sit near or over the $150 league cap; re-check at the next price update and trim if needed.
themeLabel: Discard lock + mill, then steal from their graveyards
